subject: Information about upcoming feature releases
description: I really enjoy using your product, but I was wondering if there is a roadmap available for upcoming updates. Are there any plans to add integration support for third-party software in the near future?

subject: Cannot log in after password reset
description: I requested a password reset link earlier today but it is not working. Every time I try to set a new password, the page refreshes and gives me an error message. I really need to get into my account to check my recent activity.

subject: Export functionality stuck at zero percent
description: The report export feature seems to be broken. Every time I trigger a CSV download, the progress bar remains at zero percent indefinitely. I am using the latest version of Chrome, is there a known issue with this?

subject: Time tracking report feature
description: Is there any way to generate a summary report of hours spent on specific projects? I need this for my client invoicing every month. A simple bar chart or downloadable PDF would be perfect.

subject: Performance degradation after latest update
description: Ever since the software updated last night, everything feels much more sluggish. Buttons take longer to respond to clicks and the general responsiveness is just not the same. Please roll back the performance changes or fix this bug.

subject: Duplicate alert messages
description: I am getting the exact same notification sent to me twice in a row every time. It is a bit spammy and annoying to clear out my inbox. Is there a setting I missed to prevent duplicates?

subject: Trying to delete my account
description: I no longer have a use for this service and would like to close my account permanently. Could you please explain the process for doing this? Please let me know if there is anything I need to back up first.

subject: Integration import failed for large file
description: Attempted to import a data file of 500MB and the system threw a memory exception. I expected the import to handle large files in chunks. Please advise on the maximum file size limit or if there is a streaming option available.

subject: Desktop browser notifications not working
description: I granted permission for desktop alerts in Chrome, but nothing pops up when I receive a reply. I have verified that my system focus assist is turned off. Could you guide me through the troubleshooting steps?

subject: Payment failed despite sufficient funds
description: My subscription was just suspended, but I have more than enough money in my account to cover the cost. It seems like the system failed to process the transaction properly. Please investigate why the payment was declined.

subject: Double charge on my monthly subscription
description: I noticed that I was charged twice for my subscription this month. Could you please check my account and refund the extra transaction? I would appreciate a quick resolution to this.

subject: Unable to export data to CSV
description: I am trying to export my monthly history, but the file download doesn't trigger. The browser developer console shows a failed network request to the export server. Could you please let me know if this feature is currently broken?

subject: Stuck in infinite login loop
description: After entering my credentials and passing the two-factor authentication, the page just refreshes back to the sign-in screen. I have cleared my browser cache and tried using an incognito window without success. This is preventing me from getting any work done today.

subject: Trouble updating payment info
description: I am getting a generic error whenever I try to save my new debit card. I have confirmed with my bank that the card is active and has sufficient funds. Is there a specific browser I should be using?

subject: Sorting function not working on numeric columns
description: The sort feature in the data viewer is treating my numeric columns like text, so 10 comes before 2. This is extremely frustrating when trying to rank items by value. Can you fix the column formatting so that it sorts correctly?

subject: Are you hiring for remote positions?
description: I am a huge fan of your product and I am looking for new career opportunities. Do you have a careers page where I can see current openings? I would love to join the team if the right role is available.

subject: Unexpected session timeout during data import
description: Every time I start a large data import, the session times out about five minutes in, leaving my data half-uploaded. Is there a way to increase the timeout limit or use a different method for large batches? This is very frustrating.

subject: Unable to disable security questions
description: I find the security questions extremely outdated and would prefer to use an authenticator app instead. Every time I try to update my settings, the interface freezes. Please tell me how I can switch to a more modern authentication method.

subject: Historical data query performance is poor
description: Running any queries against data from more than six months ago takes forever and often crashes the browser. Is there a way to index these older records to speed up the retrieval? This is slowing down my research significantly.

subject: Website responsiveness is terrible on mobile
description: The mobile version of your site is incredibly sluggish, specifically when trying to scroll through lists. Buttons take forever to register a click, which makes the whole experience frustrating. Please optimize your scripts for mobile browsers.

subject: How do I switch to annual billing?
description: I'm currently on a monthly billing cycle, but I'd like to switch to the annual plan to take advantage of the discount. I can't seem to find the toggle for this in the billing settings. Could you guide me through the process?

subject: Authenticator app desynced
description: My phone broke and I lost access to my authenticator app. Now I cannot get the six-digit code required to enter my account. Can you reset the MFA settings for me?

subject: Unexpected application slowdowns
description: The platform works great for the first hour of my session, but then it starts to slow down significantly. It feels like a memory leak that gets worse the longer I stay logged in. Do you have any suggestions to mitigate this?

subject: Billing address update for invoices
description: I need to update the billing address on all my future invoices because my business has moved. I updated it in the profile settings, but the old address is still appearing on the generated PDF. How can I ensure the new address is reflected?

subject: Integrate with third-party calendar apps
description: It would be incredibly helpful if your platform could sync directly with my calendar. Manually typing in deadlines is prone to error and takes up valuable time. Are there any plans to build this integration?

subject: Subscription not recognized after login
description: I logged into my account successfully, but it shows that I don't have an active subscription. I paid for the premium plan last month and have the receipt. Can you please check my account status?

subject: Inquiry regarding billing date
description: I would like to change my billing date to the first of the month to align with my salary. Is it possible to schedule my subscription renewal for a specific day? Please let me know if this is a supported feature.

subject: Reporting a potential security vulnerability
description: I believe I found a flaw in your user registration form that allows for potential data leakage. I would like to report this to your security team responsibly. Please let me know who I should contact to provide the details.

subject: Slow login process
description: I have been waiting for the authentication screen to complete for ages. It just spins and spins after I enter my credentials. Is the authentication server down or just extremely slow?

subject: System slow during peak hours
description: Everything works fine in the morning, but by 2 PM, the platform becomes incredibly sluggish. It feels like server congestion or something similar. Do you have planned maintenance during these times that might be causing this?

subject: How do I switch my payment method?
description: My current credit card is about to expire soon and I want to update my billing info before it does. Where exactly do I go to change the card on file? I don't want to lose access to my tools.

subject: Suspicious login attempt from unknown device
description: I received an alert about a login from a location I have never visited. I immediately changed my password, but I want to know if there is any way to see what actions were taken during that session. Please help me secure my account further.

subject: How to change subscription owner
description: I am leaving my company and need to transfer the subscription ownership to my colleague. Can you please assist us in moving the billing responsibility to a new profile? We need to keep the existing project history intact.

subject: Archiving feature for old tasks
description: My task list is bloated with completed items from last year. Can we get an archive button that hides these completed tasks but doesn't delete them permanently? That way I can keep my current workspace clean.

subject: Unable to toggle desktop sound notifications
description: I have tried disabling the sound for desktop notifications in my preferences, but they keep beeping. I need these to be silent while I am working. Please let me know how to force this off.

subject: Request for quiet hours feature
description: I love the app but the constant notifications at night are disruptive. Is there a way to implement a 'Do Not Disturb' mode or scheduled quiet hours? I don't want to turn off alerts completely, just during sleep hours.

subject: Auto-save feature overwriting data
description: The auto-save function is overwriting my manual edits whenever I move to a new field. It is incredibly disruptive to my workflow and I keep losing progress on my data entry. Please tell me how to disable this feature.

subject: System error during account verification
description: I was prompted to verify my account details upon login, but the page keeps crashing and showing a generic error code. I have tried waiting a few hours to see if it was a temporary glitch, but it persists. I am unable to proceed past this verification screen.

subject: Blank screen after logging in
description: I enter my credentials and the screen just goes white. I have tried disabling all my browser extensions, but that did not fix it. What could be causing this display issue?

subject: Data synchronization latency
description: There is a significant delay between when a record is updated in the mobile app and when it appears in the web console. It used to be almost instant, but lately, it takes several minutes. Is there a way to force a refresh?

subject: Problem accessing billing history
description: I am trying to download my invoices from the past six months, but the download link returns a 404 error. I really need these for my tax filing this week. Is there any other way to get these documents sent to me?

subject: Report potential phishing attempt
description: I received an email claiming to be from your company asking me to click a link to update my billing information. It looks somewhat suspicious and the sender address seems off. I wanted to report this so other users don't get tricked by the same scam.

subject: API key exposure
description: I accidentally committed my production API key to a public repository by mistake. I have already deleted the repository, but I need to know how to revoke the existing key and generate a new one. This is quite urgent.

subject: Add social media sharing buttons to blog posts
description: I really enjoy your platform, but I'm finding it difficult to share content directly to my professional network. Could you please integrate social media sharing buttons into the interface? It would help us promote our work much more effectively.

subject: Inquiry about upcoming feature releases
description: I saw a mention of a new update on your social media page recently. Is there an official roadmap I can view to see what new tools are coming out soon? I am very excited about the progress.

subject: Unable to change password
description: I want to update my login credentials, but the change password button is greyed out. I am currently logged in but I need to make sure my account is secure. Can you assist me with this?

subject: Double billed for the same month
description: It looks like I was charged twice for my subscription this month. I have two separate transactions showing on my card statement from the same date. Please investigate this double billing error.

subject: User-defined themes for shared workspaces
description: Our team would love to be able to apply our brand colors to our shared workspace. It would help us identify our projects at a glance. Can you allow us to customize the interface colors for specific workspaces?

subject: Subscription not showing in my dashboard
description: I upgraded to the premium version, but my dashboard still says I am on a trial. The charge already cleared on my bank account, so I am very confused. Please investigate why my subscription status hasn't updated yet.

subject: Not receiving push notifications on mobile
description: I have checked my settings and push notifications are enabled, but I never get alerts for new messages. I have already tried reinstalling the app twice to fix this. It is really frustrating missing these important updates.
